mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 1.5%, it signals the Federal Reserve is behind the curve on inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by high housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 17000), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and anticipation of monetary tightening, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances meeting the late-cycle condition, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105 signals manufacturing sector weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the slowdown impacts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 105, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) falls below 100 thousand and unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0%, it signals a contracting labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 250 signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 250, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105 and housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1200, it signals a broad economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
